'''Leonard Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Naboo Regionals]] on 4 June 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|X-wing Swarm (Hidden Base/Rebel Fleet)]], according to Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d860">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fired860/ naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fire], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 9 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fired860/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
